about: Frozen 2026-11-10, written AFTER the Motor Vehicles Act patterns were widened using the two earlier sets (both are development sets now). Run ONCE, no tuning afterwards. Written by Claude (not a lawyer).
positives: A lorry loaded with sand rolled back on a slope and hit a parked car; the cleaner was seriously injured.
My nephew was riding a motorcycle without a helmet when a van hit him and he is in coma. Can the family get anything from the van owner's insurer?
The bus driver did not give way to the ambulance and the patient died on the way.
A tanker driver, drunk at the time, was arrested after the tanker mowed down three pedestrians.
Our auto was stopped by the traffic police who demanded the permit and the fitness papers.
An unregistered Bullet was seized by the police during a vehicle check.
The driver left the injured motorcyclist on the road and drove off after the dumper hit him.
Is the owner of a truck responsible if the driver had no valid licence at the time of the accident?
A car going at high speed lost control and killed a street dog and injured a boy who tried to save it.
Can I get compensation if I was hit by a vehicle which was never traced?
The state transport bus overturned on the ghat road and seventeen passengers were injured.
My son, 17, took my Activa and knocked down an old man; the man has a fractured hip.
The cab driver was challaned for not carrying the vehicle's registration papers.
After the pickup truck hit the roadside shop, the driver slipped away in the dark.
What is the fine for talking on a mobile phone while driving a car?
The company vehicle had no pollution certificate when the transport officer checked it.
negatives: The accused stabbed his neighbour during a quarrel about parking.
A man is accused of raping a woman after offering her a lift in his car.
My client is accused of forging a sale deed for agricultural land.
The shopkeeper sold me a defective helmet and refuses to return the money.
The cab company has terminated the contract of the driver without notice.
A gang looted the bank and escaped in a stolen van.
The mob burnt a truck during the agitation.
The patient died during surgery and the hospital refuses to give the records.
My bike was stolen and the police have not registered an FIR.
The employer has not paid the driver's provident fund contribution.
The accused strangled the victim and dumped the body in a car boot.
I want to challenge the order of eviction passed against me.
A man died after eating poisoned food at a wedding.
The accused threatened the bus owner to hand over money every month.
Can I withdraw my complaint after the settlement in a cheque case?
The accused allegedly sexually assaulted a girl in a moving car.
